recommendations.title: Spontaneous coronary artery dissection
recommendations.text: In patients with spontaneous coronary artery dissection, PCI is recommended only for patients with symptoms and signs of ongoing myocardial ischaemia, a large area of myocardium in jeopardy, and reduced antegrade flow.

recommendations.title: Thrombus aspiration
recommendations.text: The routine use of thrombus aspiration is not recommended.

recommendations.title: Management of patients with multivessel disease
recommendations.text: It is recommended to base the revascularization strategy (IRA PCI, multivessel PCI/CABG) on the patient's clinical status and comorbidities, as well as their disease complexity, according to the principles of management of myocardial revascularization.

content.notes: IRA = infarct-related artery; PCI = percutaneous coronary intervention; CABG = coronary artery bypass grafting.
